verdict.rationale: Gmail documents that Gemini can 'delete multiple emails or add labels', which is a native AI-driven bulk action. Filters can also automatically add or remove labels on matching messages, but they act on incoming mail by rule rather than as an on-demand bulk operation over existing items. Missing for 10: documented API batch or bulk-modify endpoints, details on the scope and limits of Gemini bulk actions (archive, move, mark read across large sets), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
When a message matches, filters automatically trigger actions such as adding or removing labels, or forwarding the email to a specified address.
